mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id, p.name AS place_name, p.is_closed, p.first_image, m.name AS owner_name FROM place p JOIN member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.member_id = #{bizMemberId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.visitor_name, r.phone, r.visit_date, r.headcount, r.status, r.created_at, r.cancel_reason, r.cancel_requested_at, p.name AS place_name, pay.amount, pay.payment_status FROM reservation r JOIN place p ON p.place_id = r.place_id LEFT JOIN payment pay ON pay.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId} AND r.visit_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY r.reservation_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(r.visit_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(r.visit_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND r.status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'EXPIRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthly_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.visit_date = CURDATE() AND r.status = 'PAID' THEN r.headcount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_visitors, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancel_request_count FROM reservation r WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_series.month_start, '%c월') AS month_label, COALESCE(agg.booking_count, 0) AS booking_count, COALESCE(agg.revenue, 0) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL n MONTH) AS month_start FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) n_list ) month_series LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.visit_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS booking_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN COALESCE(pay.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN payment pay ON pay.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.visit_date, '%Y-%m-01') ) agg ON agg.month_start = month_series.month_start ORDER BY month_series.month_start

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancel_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_count FROM reservation r JOIN place p ON p.place_id = r.place_id WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.member_id = #{bizMemberId}

SELECT d.closed_date FROM place_closed_date d JOIN place p ON p.place_id = d.place_id WHERE d.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.member_id = #{bizMemberId} AND d.closed_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY d.closed_date

SELECT region_id FROM region WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL AND region_name = CASE WHEN #{address} LIKE '서울%' THEN '서울특별시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '부산%' THEN '부산광역시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '대구%' THEN '대구광역시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '인천%' THEN '인천광역시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '광주%' THEN '전남광주통합특별시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '대전%' THEN '대전광역시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '울산%' THEN '울산광역시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '세종%' THEN '세종특별자치시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '경기%' THEN '경기도' WHEN #{address} LIKE '강원%' THEN '강원특별자치도' WHEN #{address} LIKE '충북%' OR #{address} LIKE '충청북도%' THEN '충청북도' WHEN #{address} LIKE '충남%' OR #{address} LIKE '충청남도%' THEN '충청남도' WHEN #{address} LIKE '전북%' OR #{address} LIKE '전라북도%' THEN '전북특별자치도' WHEN #{address} LIKE '전남%' OR #{address} LIKE '전라남도%' THEN '전남광주통합특별시' WHEN #{address} LIKE '경북%' OR #{address} LIKE '경상북도%' THEN '경상북도' WHEN #{address} LIKE '경남%' OR #{address} LIKE '경상남도%' THEN '경상남도' WHEN #{address} LIKE '제주%' THEN '제주특별자치도' ELSE NULL END LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_image (place_id, image_url, sort_order) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id, p.name, p.place_type, p.min_price, p.region_id, r.region_name, p.address, p.description, p.extra_info, p.hashtags, p.is_closed FROM place p LEFT JOIN region r ON r.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.member_id = #{bizMemberId} LIMIT 1
SELECT image_url FROM place_image WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY sort_order
mapper.update: UPDATE place SET name = #{name}, place_type = #{placeType}, min_price = #{minPrice}, region_id = #{regionId}, address = #{address}, description = #{description}, extra_info = #{extraInfo}, first_image = #{firstImage}, hashtags = #{hashtags} WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.content FROM post p LEFT JOIN review_analysis ra ON ra.post_id = p.post_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.category = '방문자인증후기' AND ra.post_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_analysis (post_id, place_id, sentiment, keywords) VALUES (#{postId}, #{placeId}, #{sentiment}, CAST(#{keywordsJson} AS JSON))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS positiveCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS negativeCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS neutralCount FROM review_analysis WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT keywords FROM review_analysis WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND keywords IS NOT NULL
